run_ovseg_training: run the OVSeg training script with a config file to train an open vocabulary segmentation model
run_ovseg_evaluation: run the OVSeg evaluation script to evaluate a trained model on a test dataset
build_trainer_optimizer: build the Trainer optimizer with configurable SGD or AdamW and gradient clipping support
build_trainer_evaluator: build the Trainer evaluator for semantic segmentation datasets with optional dense CRF post processing
test_trainer_with_TTA: test the Trainer model with test-time augmentation for improved segmentation accuracy
